label: Software Development
description: Full software product lifecycle from idea to deployed code
connectors: Specs generate code via AI agents

stages.label: Conception
stages.subtitle: Idea & Vision
stages.description: Capture the initial idea, problem space, and vision
stages.ai: Stress-tests your idea, identifies blind spots, suggests missing angles
stages.output: Validated concept brief ready for product definition

stages.label: Definition
stages.subtitle: Product Spec
stages.description: Translate the idea into a complete product specification
stages.ai: Flags ambiguous requirements, generates user stories from PRD, scores completeness
stages.output: Structured PRD that engineering can trust

stages.label: Architecture
stages.subtitle: System Design
stages.description: Design the system that implements the specification
stages.ai: Reviews architecture for gaps, suggests patterns, links decisions back to PRD intent
stages.output: Architecture docs linked to every PRD requirement they serve

stages.label: Implementation
stages.subtitle: Dev Specs
stages.description: Create developer-ready specifications for AI coding agents
stages.ai: Scores spec quality for AI code generation, auto-generates tickets, suggests edge cases
stages.output: Implementation-ready specs optimized for Claude Code & Copilot

stages.label: Execution
stages.subtitle: Code & Sync
stages.description: Track the living codebase and keep docs in sync
stages.ai: Watches commits, detects doc-code drift in real time, flags intent violations
stages.output: Codebase that never diverges silently from its original intent
